static_traits.name: Chen Ming宇
static_traits.family_status: 丈夫是一名Engineer，当前怀有第二个孩子
static_traits.social_status: 与丈夫的关系因对not yet来的Anxiety而紧张；有支持性的丈夫可以倾诉
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without类似心理问题或治疗史；without显著躯体疾病

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在为not yet来的工作前景感到严重的Anxiety。这些症状是在我得知自己怀上第二个孩子后开始的。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到我的Anxiety正在影响日常功能和幸福感，这促使我此时寻求咨询。我觉得需要专业的帮助来处理我的Anxiety。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/能力not足
My worth depends on whether I work outside the home and contribute economically

special_situations.event: 得知自己怀上第二个孩子
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am out of the workforce for a long time caring for two children, it will be hard for me to be hired again, which equals failure.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过对自己说“机会会出现”的方式进行自我安慰以缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我再也not会有在家外工作的机会了。

special_situations.event: On waking in the early morning, starting to think about one's own career choices after the children grow up
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法清晰规划重返职场的路径，就意味着我将失败并且not人会雇用我。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 与丈夫沟通并寻求情感上的安慰与支持
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人会雇用像我这样离开职场多年的人。

special_situations.event: 注意到并思考简历上的空档
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果简历存在空档，雇主就会认为我not胜任并negate我。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Looks up programs and resources for returning to work to find possibilities

special_situations.event: 想到自己可能without法在经济上做出贡献并担心让家人失望
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在经济上有所贡献，就会让家人失望，说明我not用。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing guilt through self-comfort and receiving affirmation from her husband

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to embody one's own worth in both family and career
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因职场中断而Being rejected与评判，从而让家人失望
defense_goal: 通过预想最坏结果和自我安慰来控制Anxiety、避免Being rejected带来的痛苦

object_relations.self_representation: 能力not足、可能not被雇用的求职者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻挑剔、negate简历空档的雇主/社会

object_relations.self_representation: 可能让家人失望的照料者
object_relations.object_representation: 支持但担心被我辜负的伴侣/家人

manifestations: 在家庭角色（两个孩子的Mother）与职业自我之间感到Restricted choices与not确定
清晨醒来即被对not yet来的not确定与恐惧笼罩
担心简历空档与skill过时影响重返职场
outcomes: 注意力与自我照顾受损

positive_force: Has a supportive husband, can communicate and receive encouragement
主动寻找信息（阅读重返职场项目）
Notices cases of others successfully returning to the workplace, with a sense of learning and hope
愿意寻求专业帮助，动机Good
negative_force: 灾难化、非黑即白、过度概括与预测not yet来等认知偏差
对not确定性高度敏感，早晨的反刍性担忧明显
担心简历空档与skill过时导致的Self-doubt
Excessively ties self-worth to working outside the home / economic contribution
Anxiety已影响日常功能与伴侣关系

target_behavior.behavior: 对not yet来工作前景的过度担忧与灾难化思维（Significant anxiety与without助感）
antecedent: 想到孩子长大后的职业选择
看到或想到简历上的空档/skill可能过时
与丈夫谈论工作与not yet来
target_behavior.core_reason: 将简历空档与全职照料角色解释为“能力not足/without人录用”，伴随非黑即白与灾难化的not yet来预测
target_behavior.function: 通过担忧和最坏情景预测获得短暂的控制感与心理准备，回避直面not确定性带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 持续紧张与胃部发紧，注意力与自我照顾受损，夫妻Relationship tension，日常功能下降
